notes: Technical report on RL training for Ring-1T; no dedicated safety section and no safety/alignment/refusal/jailbreak/dangerous-capability eval numbers. Paper Date Oct 22, 2025 is not treated as a model release date. Eval context windows (128K/64K/32K) are harness settings, not a disclosed native context length.
